title: vsigma memory bundle (schema_version 0.1)
description: The portable constructor contract. A bundle is a directory: manifest.json (validates against #/$defs/manifest) and records.jsonl (each non-empty line validates against #/$defs/record). Any tool that can write these files can build vsigma memory fully offline; commit only via `vsigma memory validate` + `vsigma memory ingest`. Extracted from the first working end-to-end slice (schema-second); changes bump schema_version and are treated as migrations.

constructor.description: Who built the bundle: model/agent identity + version, e.g. 'claude-code/2.0'.

sources.description: Inventory of the raw sources distilled, for the incremental-rebuild lifecycle (replace injected records whose sources changed).

id.description: Stable record id; re-emitting the same id at the same scope supersedes the stored record. Records are keyed by id within their own scope/kind namespace, so the same id at a different scope is a separate record.

scope.description: Scope head from the running-context ladder, e.g. 'global' or 'persona:alice'.
